Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.liquidity

Class KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.liquidity.KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity
@Entity public class KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity extends Object
Persists a requested channel-capacity operation and its worker execution state.

The row carries the requested open/close intent, satoshi estimates, optional channel/provider context, and a lease claim used by workers. Lifecycle timestamps use UTC and rowVersion enables optimistic locking so concurrent workers cannot silently overwrite one another. The transition helpers record terminal completion time and bound provider error text to the column.
